mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id::TEXT AS db_key, r.recruit_id, r.target_id, r.rating, r.content, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt, (SELECT nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT profile_file_id::TEXT FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, (SELECT title FROM t_recruit rc WHERE rc.recruit_id = r.recruit_id) AS recruit_title FROM t_review r WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY r.review_id DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 1)::TEXT AS avg_rating, COUNT(*)::TEXT AS review_cnt FROM t_review WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND target_id = #{targetId}

WITH my_meets AS ( -- 내가 함께한(종료된) 모임 SELECT rc.recruit_id, rc.title, rc.reg_id AS host_id FROM t_recruit rc WHERE rc.use_yn = 'Y' AND (rc.status_cd = 'RECRUIT02' OR (rc.meet_dt IS NOT NULL AND rc.meet_dt <> '' AND rc.meet_dt < TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AND (rc.reg_id = #{regId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = rc.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02' AND a.user_id = #{regId})) ), members AS ( -- 그 모임의 함께한 사람(주최자 + 수락 참여자) SELECT m.recruit_id, m.title, m.host_id AS member_id FROM my_meets m UNION SELECT m.recruit_id, m.title, a.user_id FROM my_meets m JOIN t_recruit_apply a ON a.recruit_id = m.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02' ) SELECT mb.recruit_id, mb.title AS recruit_title, mb.member_id AS target_id, u.nickname AS target_nm, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_review r WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.recruit_id = mb.recruit_id AND r.reg_id = #{regId} AND r.target_id = mb.member_id) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS written_yn FROM members mb LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id = mb.member_id AND u.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE mb.member_id <> #{regId} ORDER BY mb.recruit_id DESC, mb.member_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit rc WHERE rc.recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer AND rc.use_yn = 'Y' AND (rc.status_cd = 'RECRUIT02' OR (rc.meet_dt IS NOT NULL AND rc.meet_dt <> '' AND rc.meet_dt < TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AND (rc.reg_id = #{regId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = rc.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02' AND a.user_id = #{regId})) AND (rc.reg_id = #{targetId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = rc.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02' AND a.user_id = #{targetId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_review (recruit_id, target_id, rating, content, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{recruitId}::integer, #{targetId}, #{rating}::integer, NULLIF(#{content}, ''), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.select: SELECT review_id::TEXT AS db_key, recruit_id, target_id, rating, content, reg_id FROM t_review WHERE review_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_review SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE review_id = #{dbKey}::integer
